Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

DECLARE
 HDATE DATE;
BEGIN
 IF :System.TRIGGER_ITEM = :System.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN
 HDATE := TO_DATE(:System.Cursor_Value);

 IF NOT HIJDATE.VALID_HIJ_DATE(HDATE) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 BELL;
 COMMIT;

 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) AND :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'QUERY' THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

 :title.user_name := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
 :title.SCREEN_NAME := :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME;
 :title.SYSTEM_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(-1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

/* Check that foreign key value exists in referenced table */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_(
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD') IS NOT NULL AND name_in('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_STATU(
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
 ,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'W', 'OFG', 13);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

BEGIN

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT DCLTN_STA_DESC INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;




 :GLOBAL.DISPLAY_ALL :=1;
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 0;



-- --
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;


/* CHK-DCLTN-B4-CLR */
BEGIN

/*
 IF CHK_DCLTN_B4_DISPLAY = 0 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 */
 IF :SYSTEM.CURRENT_FORM = 'DCLN2295' THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') THEN
 DECLARE
 v_count NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn
 AND dgt_type = 7
 ;

 IF v_count > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('هذا البيان له فسح شاحنه جزئي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

 ----------nihad khalil fagem 21/04/2009 for special department
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
:SPCL_DEPT_FILLER1 := :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID;
ELSE
SELECT filler1 INTO :SPCL_DEPT_FILLER1 FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);
END IF;
DECLARE
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 CURSOR DSDR IS
 SELECT DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(700);
 V_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(200);


BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 FOR I IN DSDR LOOP
 SELECT DEPT_NAME INTO V_DEPT_NAME FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS
 WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = I.DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;

 v_spcl_dept_name := v_spcl_dept_name||','|| v_dept_name;

 END LOOP;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME :=SUBSTR(V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME,2);


 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC :=' معروض على '||V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 BEGIN
 SELECT DEPT_NAME INTO V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS
 WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;

 EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN -- RE: إعادة توجيه: وجود عوائدارضيات بعد التحصيل ميناء الملك عبدالعزيز

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 intrface.Disp_date_con('H', 2, 1);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

 V_CLRNC_TYPE NUMBER;

 V_STMT_ISN NUMBER;
 V_STATS_ISN NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MFST_STATUS NUMBER;
 V_BLD_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_BLD_LEFT_CD NUMBER;
 V_BILL_STATUS BILLS.BILL_STATUS%TYPE;
 V_BLD_PORT_CD BILLS.PORT_CD%TYPE;
 V_BLD_CARR_PREFIX BILLS.CARR_PREFIX%TYPE;
 V_BLD_BILL_NBR BILLS.BILL_NBR%TYPE;
 V_BLD_BILL_DT BILLS.BILL_DT%TYPE;

 :GLOBAL.DLVY_NBR := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.DLVY_DT := NULL;

IF :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL THEN

 :GLOBAL.DLVY_DT := :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT;
END IF;
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF :GLOBAL.DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :GLOBAL.DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL AND :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS IN ('NEW','INSERT') THEN

BEGIN
 IF dcltn.chk_prohib_ctry_a_im (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd,
 :air_dlvy_orders.dlvy_nbr,
 :air_dlvy_orders.dlvy_dt
 ) = 1
 THEN
 ret :=
 str.dispalert ('لا يسمح بإستيراد أو تصدير أي سلعة من دول المقاطعة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE



-----------this is for drct clrnc

/*
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DRCT_CLRNC =1 THEN

SELECT COUNT(1) INTO FOUND FROM DRCT_CLRNC_DTLS WHERE
 CLRNC_CONFIRM = 1 AND CLRNC_CONFIRM_DT IS NOT NULL AND PORT_CD=:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DLVY_NBR=:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR AND DLVY_DT=:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT;
 IF FOUND =0 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT(' يجب الربط بإذونات التسليم المفسوحة بالشرح ','ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_QTY := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;
 --WAKEEL CR_6555
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_AMNT := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT:= NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_CURRENCY := NULL ;
 --WAKEEL CR_6555
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


END IF;
*/

 IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD = 1 THEN

 BEGIN

 SELECT ADO.CLRNC_TYPE, ADO.STMT_ISN, NVL(MD.MFST_STATUS,0), ADO.STATS_ISN, BLD.BILL_TYPE_CD,BLD.LEFT_CD,BLD.PORT_CD,
 BLD.CARR_PREFIX,BLD.BILL_NBR,BLD.BILL_DT
 INTO V_CLRNC_TYPE,V_STMT_ISN, V_MFST_STATUS, V_STATS_ISN, V_BLD_TYPE , V_BLD_LEFT_CD , V_BLD_PORT_CD,
 V_BLD_CARR_PREFIX,V_BLD_BILL_NBR,V_BLD_BILL_DT
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS ADO, BILL_DTLS BLD, MFST_DTLS MD
 WHERE ADO.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND ADO.DLVY_NBR = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR
 AND ADO.DLVY_DT = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT
 AND BLD.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND BLD.CARR_PREFIX = ADO.CARR_PREFIX
 AND BLD.BILL_NBR = ADO.BILL_NBR
 AND BLD.BILL_DT = ADO.BILL_DT
 AND BLD.SHPMT_TYPE = ADO.SHPMT_TYPE
 AND BLD.MFST_NBR = ADO.MFST_NBR
 AND BLD.MFST_YEAR = ADO.MFST_YEAR
 AND BLD.MFST_TYPE = ADO.MFST_TYPE
 AND MD.PORT_CD = ADO.PORT_CD
 AND MD.MFST_NBR = ADO.MFST_NBR
 AND MD.SHPMT_TYPE= ADO.SHPMT_TYPE
 AND MD.MFST_YEAR = ADO.MFST_YEAR
 AND MD.MFST_TYPE = ADO.MFST_TYPE
 ;

 IF V_BLD_TYPE = 2 THEN

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_QTY := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;
 --WAKEEL CR_6555

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT:= NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_CURRENCY := NULL ;

 ELSIF V_BLD_TYPE = 3 OR NVL(V_BLD_LEFT_CD,0)>0 THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT(' لا يمكن ربط الإذن علي البيان - البوليصة من متروكات الجمرك','ERROR');

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME := NULL;

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;
 --WAKEEL CR_6555

--&&& END

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_QTY := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;
 --WAKEEL CR_6555
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_AMNT := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT:= NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_CURRENCY := NULL ;

 update_isn(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:GLOBAL.DLVY_NBR,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:GLOBAL.DLVY_DT);

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');

 STR.DISPALERT('تم ربط إذن التسليم علي البيان الجمركي','INFORMATION');

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME := NULL;

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_CURRENCY := NULL ;

/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR := :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR;

/* CGFK$QRY_LOOKUP_DATA */
/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */
BEGIN
 IF ( name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_YEAR') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE') IS NOT NULL
 OR name_in('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_AIR_DLVY_ORDERS_A_DLV(
 :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.L_BLD_MFST_QTY /* MOD: Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.L_BLD_MFST_QTY. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BLD_WT /* MOD: Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BLD_WT. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE. */
 ,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_YEAR ); /* IN : Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_YEAR. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بوليصة غير موجودة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رقم بوليصة صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'AIR_DLVY_ORDERS', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
END;

/* CGFK$RESET_BLOCK_WHERE_CLAUSE */
/* Resets block where clause */

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN -- START WAKEEL DM_0142
IF :GLOBAL.BILLS_DCLTN =1 THEN -- WAKEEL DM_0142
 :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR := :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR;
 :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX :=:GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX ;
 :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT := :GLOBAL.BILL_DT ;
END IF ;
 :GLOBAL.BILLS_DCLTN := 0 ;
END ;

-- END WAKEEL DM_0142
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.AIR_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.AIR_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.AIR_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BLD_WT');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(MFST_WT '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(MFST_WT '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(MFST_WT) LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(MFST_WT ='|| r_string || ')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 r_string := NAME_IN('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.L_BLD_MFST_QTY');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(MFST_QTY '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(MFST_QTY '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(MFST_QTY) LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(MFST_QTY ='|| r_string || ')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(MFST_YEAR), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(MFST_TYPE), ''CG$NULL''), SHPMT_TYPE, nvl(BILL_NBR, ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD, nvl(to_char(CARR_PREFIX), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(MFST_NBR),
 ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(BILL_DT), ''CG$NULL'')) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(MFST_YEAR), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(MFST_TYPE), ''CG$NULL''), SHPMT_TYPE, nvl(BILL_NBR, ''CG$NULL''), PORT_CD, nvl(to_char(CARR_PREFIX), ''CG$NULL''),
 nvl(to_char(MFST_NBR), ''CG$NULL''), nvl(to_char(BILL_DT), ''CG$NULL'') '||'FROM BILL_DTLS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DLVY_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FREIGHT_FORWARDER_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DLVY_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,IMPR_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'OPRTN_USER,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_SUPER_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,OPRTN_SUPERVISOR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_STMT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيان الإستيراد هذا غير موجود - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار بيان موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('البيان الإحصائي هذا غير موجود - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار بيان موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز الجمرك غير صحيح - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_MD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوعه,المانفيست,لسنة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_MAN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'المانفيست,لسنة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'تاريخ البوليصة,رقم البوليصة,ناقل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_BILLD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بوليصة غير موجودة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رقم بوليصة صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'أذن التسليم','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'أذن التسليم','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
SELECT b.owner_name,b.tot_org_wt,b.tot_org_qty,BILL_PRICE_AMNT, BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT,CU.CURCY_ARBC_NAME -- WAKEEL CR_6555 CHECK ADD DESIGN
INTO :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME,:AIR_BL_DTLS.tot_org_wt,:AIR_BL_DTLS.tot_org_qty ,:AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_AMNT,:AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT,:AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_CURRENCY
FROM bills b,bill_dtls bd ,CURRENCIES CU
WHERE b.PORT_CD=bd.port_cd AND b.CARR_PREFIX=bd.carr_prefix
AND b.BILL_NBR=bd.BILL_NBR AND b.BILL_DT=bd.BILL_DT
AND bd.PORT_CD= :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.port_cd AND bd.CARR_PREFIX = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.carr_prefix
AND bd.BILL_NBR=:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR AND bd.BILL_DT=:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT
AND bd.SHPMT_TYPE= :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE AND bd.MFST_NBR = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR
AND bd.MFST_YEAR = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_YEAR
AND bd.MFST_TYPE = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE
AND B.BILL_CURRENCY = CU.CURCY_CD ;


 :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR := :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_DT := :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT;
 :GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX := :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX;
 :GLOBAL.AIR_DLVY_ORDERS := 1 ;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT := :AIR_BL_DTLS.F_BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT ; -- wakeel cr_6555
 :GLOBAL.TOT_ORG_WT := :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT ; -- wakeel cr_6555

EXCEPTION

WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;


END;

 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);

 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(

 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION

 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 BILL_REC BILLS%ROWTYPE;
 BILL_COUNT NUMBER;
 --wakeel cr_6555
 v_BILL_DT DATE;
 v_BILL_STATUS NUMBER;
 v_STMT_ISN NUMBER;
 v_STATS_ISN NUMBER;
 v_OWNER_NAME VARCHAR2(500);
 v_MFST_NBR NUMBER;
 v_MFST_YEAR NUMBER;
 v_BILL_PRE_TYPE NUMBER;
 v_FINAL_CTRY_CD NUMBER;
 v_TOT_ORG_WT NUMBER;
 v_TOT_ORG_QTY NUMBER;
--wakeel cr_6555
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO BILL_COUNT
 FROM BILLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :BILLS.PORT_CD
 AND BILL_NBR = :BILLS.BILL_NBR
 AND CARR_PREFIX = :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX
 AND (
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) )
 OR
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 3 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) )
 ) -- MAIH 16-03-2013 بوالص وارد وصادر --
 AND ( (bill_dhl = 1 AND :parameter.p_post_express = 1)
 OR (:parameter.p_post_express <> 1)
 )
 -- AND (BILL_DHL = 1 AND :parameter.p_post_express = 1 )-- MAIH
 ;


 IF BILL_COUNT > 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO BILL_COUNT
 FROM BILLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :BILLS.PORT_CD
 AND BILL_NBR = :BILLS.BILL_NBR
 AND CARR_PREFIX = :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX
 AND (
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) )
 OR
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 3 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) )
 ) -- MAIH 16-03-2013 بوالص وارد وصادر --
 AND ( (bill_dhl = 1 AND :parameter.p_post_express = 1)
 OR (:parameter.p_post_express <> 1)
 )

 AND BILL_STATUS IN (2 , 4)
 AND STMT_ISN IS NULL
 AND STATS_ISN IS NULL
 ;

 IF BILL_COUNT > 1 THEN
 LOV_BILLS(TRUE);
 ELSIF BILL_COUNT = 1 THEN

 SELECT BILL_DT
 ,BILL_STATUS
 ,STMT_ISN
 ,STATS_ISN
 ,OWNER_NAME
 ,MFST_NBR
 ,MFST_YEAR
 ,BILL_PRE_TYPE
 ,FINAL_CTRY_CD
 ,TOT_ORG_WT
 ,TOT_ORG_QTY
 INTO
 v_BILL_DT ,
 v_BILL_STATUS ,
 v_STMT_ISN ,
 v_STATS_ISN ,
 v_OWNER_NAME ,
 v_MFST_NBR ,
 v_MFST_YEAR ,
 v_BILL_PRE_TYPE,
 v_FINAL_CTRY_CD,
 v_TOT_ORG_WT ,
 v_TOT_ORG_QTY
 FROM BILLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :BILLS.PORT_CD
 AND BILL_NBR = :BILLS.BILL_NBR
 AND CARR_PREFIX = :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX
 AND (
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) )
 OR
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 3 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) )
 ) -- MAIH 16-03-2013 بوالص وارد وصادر --
 AND ( (bill_dhl = 1 AND :parameter.p_post_express = 1)
 OR (:parameter.p_post_express <> 1)
 )

 AND BILL_STATUS IN (2, 4)
 AND STMT_ISN IS NULL
 AND STATS_ISN IS NULL
 ;

 :BILLS.BILL_DT := v_BILL_DT;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :BILLS.PORT_CD ;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR := :BILLS.BILL_NBR ;
 :GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX := :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_DT := :BILLS.BILL_DT ;
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('البوالص بهذا الرقم مربوطه ببيان سابق أو أن حالتها غير مؤكده وغير مقدمة لقسم المراجعة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF BILL_COUNT = 1 THEN
 --wakeel cr_6555
 SELECT BILL_DT
 ,BILL_STATUS
 ,STMT_ISN
 ,STATS_ISN
 ,OWNER_NAME
 ,MFST_NBR
 ,MFST_YEAR
 ,BILL_PRE_TYPE
 ,FINAL_CTRY_CD
 ,TOT_ORG_WT
 ,TOT_ORG_QTY
 INTO
 v_BILL_DT ,
 v_BILL_STATUS ,
 v_STMT_ISN ,
 v_STATS_ISN ,
 v_OWNER_NAME ,
 v_MFST_NBR ,
 v_MFST_YEAR ,
 v_BILL_PRE_TYPE ,
 v_FINAL_CTRY_CD ,
 v_TOT_ORG_WT ,
 v_TOT_ORG_QTY
 FROM BILLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :BILLS.PORT_CD
 AND BILL_NBR = :BILLS.BILL_NBR
 AND CARR_PREFIX = :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX
 AND (
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) )
 OR
 (BILL_PRE_TYPE = 3 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) )
 ) -- MAIH 16-03-2013 بوالص وارد وصادر --
 AND ( (bill_dhl = 1 AND :parameter.p_post_express = 1)
 OR (:parameter.p_post_express <> 1)
 )
 ;
 IF v_BILL_STATUS NOT IN (2, 4) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' حالة البوليصه غير مؤكده وغير مقدمة للمراجعة', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF v_BILL_STATUS = 5 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('البوليصه مفسوحه', 'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF v_STMT_ISN IS NULL AND v_STATS_ISN IS NULL THEN
 :BILLS.BILL_DT := v_BILL_DT;

 :BILLS.OWNER_NAME := v_OWNER_NAME;
 :BILLS.STMT_ISN := v_STMT_ISN;
 :BILLS.MFST_NBR := v_MFST_NBR;
 :BILLS.MFST_YEAR := v_MFST_YEAR;

 :BILLS.OWNER_NAME_STD := str.strformat (v_OWNER_NAME);
 :BILLS.BILL_STATUS := v_BILL_STATUS;

 :BILLS.BILL_PRE_TYPE := v_BILL_PRE_TYPE;
 :BILLS.FINAL_CTRY_CD := v_FINAL_CTRY_CD;

 :BILLS.TOT_ORG_WT := v_TOT_ORG_WT;
 :BILLS.TOT_ORG_QTY := v_TOT_ORG_QTY;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :BILLS.PORT_CD ;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR := :BILLS.BILL_NBR ;
 :GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX := :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_DT := :BILLS.BILL_DT ;
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
--wakeel cr_6555
 ELSE
 IF v_STMT_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' البوليصه تم ربطها على بيان جمركي سابق برقم مبدئي'||NVL(v_STMT_ISN, ' '), 'ERROR');
 ELSIF v_STATS_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' البوليصه تم ربطها على بيان إحصائي سابق برقم مبدئي'||NVL(v_STATS_ISN, ' '), 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا توجد بوليصه شحن صادر بهذا الرقم لنفس الشركه الناقله','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END;
END;

BEGIN
 IF dcltn.chk_prohib_ctry_a_ex (:GLOBAL.dcltn_port_cd,
 :GLOBAL.carr_prefix,
 :GLOBAL.bill_nbr,
 :GLOBAL.bill_dt
 ) = 1
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يسمح بإستيراد أو تصدير أي سلعة من دول المقاطعة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 IF NOT activity.add_activity (21,
 1,
 4,
 :dcltn_hdr.port_cd
 || '!'
 || :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn
 )
 THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 -- ins_air_dlvry_order_express; -- wakeel cr_6555 --MOVED TO BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT --MAIH
 END IF;
END;

DECLARE -- wakeel cr_6555
 v_RATE NUMBER ;
 V_SR_VALUE NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 IF:BILL_CURRENCY IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT CU.CURCY_ARBC_NAME INTO :BILLS.CURRENCY FROM CURRENCIES CU WHERE CU.CURCY_CD = :BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY;
 END IF;

 IF :BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT IS NOT NULL AND :BILL_CURRENCY IS NOT NULL THEN
 V_RATE := REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (TO_NUMBER(:BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY), hijdate_db.cur_hij_date);
 V_SR_VALUE := :BILLS.BILL_PRICE_AMNT * V_RATE;
 :BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT := ROUND(V_SR_VALUE,3) ;
 END IF;

END;
/* CGFK$VALDIDATE_FK_OVF */
/* Check that foreign key value exists in referenced table */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_BILLS_BILL_CUR_FK(
 :BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY); /* IN : Value in Item :BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'BILL_STMT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيان الإستيراد هذا غير موجود - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار بيان موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SHPG_AGNT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('البيان الإحصائي هذا غير موجود - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار بيان موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز الجمرك غير صحيح - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_PRT_TYP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FINAL_PORT_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_MD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا المانفيست غير موجودة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'IMPR_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_FP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الوصول النهائي - إستخدم القائمة لإخيار رمز جمرك صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CUR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'العملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'OWNER_CITY_CODE,FINAL_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز الدولة غير صحيح - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_CR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الشركة الناقلة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار رمز شركة صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_BILL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'CARR_PREFIX,MASTER_BILL_NBR,PORT_CD,BILL_DT' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_AGCRCY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في سعر العملة - إستخدم القائمة لإختيار سعر العملة الصحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'البوالص','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'البوالص','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

SELECT B.BILL_PRICE_AMNT, B.BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT,B.BILL_CURRENCY,CU.CURCY_ARBC_NAME -- WAKEEL CR_6555 CHECK ADD DESIGN

WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;


END;
END;

DECLARE

v_do_rec_do_nbr NUMBER;

v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN NUMBER;

 DO_STA_CD,DCLTN_ISN,STATS_DCLTN_ISN,EDI_STA_CD,PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,LAST_DCLTN_ISN
 INTO v_do_rec_port_cd,v_do_rec_shpg_agnt_nbr,v_do_rec_do_nbr,v_do_rec_do_iss_dt,v_do_rec_IMPR_NBR,
 v_do_rec_DO_STA_CD,v_do_rec_DCLTN_ISN,v_do_rec_STATS_DCLTN_ISN,v_do_rec_EDI_STA_CD,v_do_rec_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('رقم الإذن المدخل غير موجود','ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;


BEGIN
 IF dcltn.chk_prohib_ctry_s_im (v_do_rec_port_cd,
 v_do_rec_shpg_agnt_nbr,

 str.dispalert ('لا يسمح بإستيراد أو تصدير أي سلعة من دول المقاطعة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE

--&&& END
 STR.DispALERT('إذن التسليم لا يربط إلا ببيان وارد', 'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF v_do_rec_DO_STA_CD <> 4 THEN
 STR.DispALERT('حالة إذن التسليم لا تسمح بربطه على البيان', 'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF v_do_rec_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT(' هذا الإذن مربوط ببيان سابق رقمه '|| v_do_rec_DCLTN_ISN,'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF v_do_rec_STATS_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DispALERT(' هذا الإذن مربوط ببيان إحصائي سابق رقمه '|| v_do_rec_STATS_DCLTN_ISN,'ERROR'); --'--
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(vssl_bls.bl_sta_cd)
 INTO BL_COUNT
 FROM sea_dlvy_orders s,
 sea_dlvy_items d,
 vssl_bl_items vss,
 vssl_bls vssl_bls
 WHERE ( (s.port_cd = d.port_cd)
 AND (s.shpg_agnt_nbr = d.shpg_agnt_nbr)
 AND (s.do_nbr = d.do_nbr)
 AND (s.do_iss_dt = d.do_iss_dt)
 AND (vss.port_cd = d.mfst_port_cd)
 AND (vss.mfst_type = d.mfst_type)
 AND (vss.mfst_nbr = d.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vss.mfst_dt = d.mfst_dt)
 AND (vss.bl_seq = d.bl_seq)
 AND (vss.item_seq = d.item_seq)
 AND (vssl_bls.port_cd = vss.port_cd)
 AND (vssl_bls.mfst_type= vss.mfst_type)
 AND (vssl_bls.mfst_nbr = vss.mfst_nbr)
 AND (vssl_bls.mfst_dt = vss.mfst_dt)
 AND (vssl_bls.bl_seq = vss.bl_seq)
 AND (vssl_bls.bl_sta_cd NOT IN (4,7, 24)) -- مسلمة ، مخزنة في منطقة إيداع ، مسلمه في جمرك التسليم--'--
 AND (s.port_cd = v_do_rec_PORT_CD)
 AND (s.shpg_agnt_nbr= v_do_rec_SHPG_AGNT_NBR)
 AND (s.do_nbr = v_do_rec_DO_NBR)
 AND (s.do_iss_dt = v_do_rec_DO_ISS_DT)
 AND (s.DO_ISS_LOC_CD<>2) -- إذن التسليم ليس مصدر بمنطقة الايداع --
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 BL_COUNT:=1;
 END;

 IF BL_COUNT>0 THEN
 STR.DispALERT( ' يوجد على هذا الإذن على الأقل بوليصة لا تسمح حالتها بربط إذن التسليم على البيان ','ERROR'); --'--
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 --[[ BY RAMY GOMAA
 -- EDI CHECKS
 IF NVL(v_do_rec_EDI_STA_CD,1)<>1 THEN
 V_MSG_OUT:='حالة إذن التسليم لا تسمح بربطه على البيان'; --'--
 STR.DispALERT(V_MSG_OUT,'ERROR');--'--
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 --]]

 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_SEA')) THEN
 IF DO_SEA.CHECK_PORT_CNTRCTR(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,v_do_rec_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,V_MSG_OUT)=0 THEN
 STR.DispALERT(V_MSG_OUT,'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 -- BEGIN BY A.HASSAN 30/10/03------------------------------------- --/* */
 BEGIN

 IF v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL AND v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN <> :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 THEN

 STR.DispALERT(' بعد طباعة البيان لا يمكن الربط الا عن طريق الجمرك..لأن هذا الإذن مفصول من بيان سابق رقمه '|| v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN,'ERROR');

 SELECT PRINT_CNT INTO LAST_DCLTN_PRINT_CNT
 FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN;

 IF :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR IS NOT NULL AND (:DCLTN_HDR.PRINT_CNT > 0 OR LAST_DCLTN_PRINT_CNT >0)
 THEN
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('هل تريد الاستمرار في ربط اذن التسليم على هذا البيان؟؟؟؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2
 THEN
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT port_cd,shpg_agnt_nbr,do_nbr,do_iss_dt,IMPR_NBR,
 DO_STA_CD,DCLTN_ISN,STATS_DCLTN_ISN,EDI_STA_CD,PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,LAST_DCLTN_ISN
 INTO v_do_rec_port_cd,v_do_rec_shpg_agnt_nbr,v_do_rec_do_nbr,v_do_rec_do_iss_dt,v_do_rec_IMPR_NBR,
 v_do_rec_DO_STA_CD,v_do_rec_DCLTN_ISN,v_do_rec_STATS_DCLTN_ISN,v_do_rec_EDI_STA_CD,v_do_rec_PORT_CNTRCTR_CD,v_do_rec_LAST_DCLTN_ISN
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE DCLTN_ISN IS NULL
 AND LAST_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL
 AND LAST_DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ROWNUM = 1;

 IF v_do_rec_SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND v_do_rec_DO_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR
 AND v_do_rec_DO_ISS_DT = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT
 THEN
 NULL;
 ELSE
 STR.DispALERT(' بعد طباعة البيان لا يمكن الربط الا عن طريق الجمرك..لأن هذا البيان مفصول عن اذن سابق رقمه '|| v_do_rec_DO_NBR,'ERROR');
 IF :PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_HDR.PRINT_CNT > 0
 THEN
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispALERT('هل تريد الاستمرار في ربط اذن التسليم الجديد على هذا البيان ؟؟؟؟','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button2
 THEN
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 NULL;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN NULL;
 END;
 -- END BY A.HASSAN 30/10/03 ------------------------------------------------


 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 2, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 UPDATE SEA_DLVY_ORDERS
 SET DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT
 ;

 --- BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT.:4853) @4/3/2006
 --- THE FOLLOWING CODE CHK. COND. [ DELARATION MUST BE LINKED TO ONE VSSL. MFST.]
 V_MANY_MFST_CHK := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DCLTN_HAS_MANY_MFST',21);
 IF (V_MANY_MFST_CHK IS NOT NULL) THEN
 IF (V_MANY_MFST_CHK = 'Y') THEN
 V_MSFT_COUNT := 0;
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_MSFT_COUNT FROM
 (
 SELECT SEA.MFST_PORT_CD, SEA.MFST_NBR, SEA.MFST_DT, SEA.MFST_TYPE
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS SEA
 WHERE ((SEA.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD) AND (SEA.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) AND (SEA.DO_ISS_LOC_CD <> 2) )
 GROUP BY SEA.MFST_PORT_CD, SEA.MFST_NBR, SEA.MFST_DT, SEA.MFST_TYPE
 );
 IF (V_MSFT_COUNT > 1) THEN
 FORMS_DDL('ROLLBACK');
 STR.DISPALERT(' إذن التسليم الجديد المطلوب ربطه مرتبط بمنافسيت بحرى يختلف عن المنافسيت الموجود بإذونات التسليم الأخرى المربوطة على البيان - برجاء أختيار إذن أخر ','ERROR');--'--
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ---

 --[[ BY RAMY GOMAA upon moh. ubo fetoh 03-01-2006
 RET :=DCLTN.CHK_AGENT_BILL_OWNER_NAMES(:SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD, :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN,NULL,NULL,NULL,'N');
 IF RET =1 THEN
 FORMS_DDL('ROLLBACK');
 STR.DISPALERT(' أسم مستورد البيان غير متطابق مع أحد أسماء مالكى بوالص إذونات التسليم المربوطة بالبيان ','ERROR');--'--
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF RET <0 THEN
 FORMS_DDL('ROLLBACK');
 STR.DISPALERT('خطأ اثناء مراجعة اسماء مالكي البوالص - راجع الحاسب الآلي','ERROR');--'--
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 --]]

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);
 STR.DISPALERT('تم ربط إذن التسليم علي البيان الجمركي','INFORMATION');




 END IF;
END;

 END IF;


 NEXT_ITEM;



END;

DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE

 END IF;

 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(DLVRD_WT)
 INTO :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SDO_WT
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD
 AND SHPG_AGNT_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND DO_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR
 AND DO_ISS_DT = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT
 ;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SDO_WT := NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 SELECT RV_MEANING
 INTO :V_DO_LOC_CD
 FROM CG_REF_CODES
 WHERE RV_DOMAIN = 'DO_ISS_LOC'
 AND RV_LOW_VALUE LIKE :DO_ISS_LOC_CD;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :V_DO_LOC_CD := NULL;


END;

/* CGFK$QRY_LOOKUP_DATA */
/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_SEA_DLVY_ORDERS_SDO_S(
 :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHAG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHAG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME. */
 ,:SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR ); /* IN : Value in Item :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد وكيل شحن بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'SEA_DLVY_ORDERS', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 END IF;
END;

/* CGFK$RESET_BLOCK_WHERE_CLAUSE */
/* Resets block where clause */
BEGIN
 IF (CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SEA_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE <> 'first_time') THEN
 set_block_property('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS', DEFAULT_WHERE, CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SEA_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE);
 CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SEA_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE := 'first_time';
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SEA_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SEA_DLVY_ORDERS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHAG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(AGNT_ARBC_NAME '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(AGNT_ARBC_NAME '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN

 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(AGNT_ARBC_NAME ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN

 EXCEPTION

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SDO_VM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد مانفيست بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد وكيل شحن بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد بيان إحصائي بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_SDP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز جمرك غير موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_SDO_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('يوجد تعديل لرقم اذن التسليم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_PCDA_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات منطقة أو مقاول التفريغ', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رقم المستورد غير صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيان الأستيراد غير موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_BO_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رمز المالك غير صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'اذن التسليم','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'اذن التسليم','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

DECLARE

IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN

 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;

IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('SDI');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SDI_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SDI_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.SDI_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SDI.L_VBI_ITEM_MARK');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SDI.L_VBI_ACTL_WGT');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ACTL_WGT '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ACTL_WGT '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(ACTL_WGT) LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ACTL_WGT ='|| r_string || ')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 r_string := NAME_IN('SDI.L_VBI_CNTNR_SEQ');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_SEQ '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_SEQ '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(to_char(CNTNR_SEQ) LIKE '''|| r_string || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_SEQ ='|| r_string || ')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((MFST_DT, MFST_TYPE, MFST_PORT_CD, ITEM_SEQ, nvl(to_char(BL_SEQ), ''CG$NULL''), MFST_NBR) IN '||'(SELECT MFST_DT, MFST_TYPE, PORT_CD, ITEM_SEQ, nvl(to_char(BL_SEQ), ''CG$NULL''), MFST_NBR
 '||'FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

DECLARE
 V_BL_REC VSSL_BLS%ROWTYPE;
 V_PREV_BL_REC VSSL_BLS%ROWTYPE;
 V_FIRST_BL BOOLEAN;
 V_BL_PARTS_APPLIED BOOLEAN;
 CURSOR C_DCLTN_BL IS SELECT * FROM VSSL_BLS WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
BEGIN
 IF :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS IN ('NEW','INSERT') THEN


BEGIN
 IF dcltn.chk_prohib_ctry_s_ex (:dcltn_hdr.port_cd,
 :vssl_bls.mfst_type,
 :vssl_bls.mfst_nbr,
 :vssl_bls.mfst_dt,
 :vssl_bls.BL_SEQ
 ) = 1
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('لا يسمح بإستيراد أو تصدير أي سلعة من دول المقاطعة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE



 BEGIN
 SELECT *
 INTO V_BL_REC
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = :VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DispALERT('رقم البوليصة المدخلة غير موجود','ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END;

--&&& END

 (:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD <> DCLTN.DT_PX AND :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE <> 2) THEN*/

--&&& END

--&&& END

 NULL; -- OK TO LINK

 NULL; -- OK TO LINK

 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
--&&& END
 STR.DispALERT('البيان البترولي لا يمكن ربطه بأكثر من بوليصة واحدة', 'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF V_PREV_BL_REC.CTRY_CD <> V_BL_REC.CTRY_CD THEN
 STR.DispALERT('بلد التفريغ في هذه البوليصة تختلف عن بلد التفريغ في باقي البوالص المربوطة على هذا البيان', 'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF V_PREV_BL_REC.PORT_CD <> V_BL_REC.PORT_CD OR V_PREV_BL_REC.MFST_TYPE <> V_BL_REC.MFST_TYPE OR
 V_PREV_BL_REC.MFST_NBR <> V_BL_REC.MFST_NBR OR V_PREV_BL_REC.MFST_DT <> V_BL_REC.MFST_DT THEN
 STR.DispALERT('منافيست هذه البوليصة يختلف عن منافيست باقي البوالص المربوطة على هذا البيان', 'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 IF V_PREV_BL_REC.OWNER_NBR <> V_BL_REC.OWNER_NBR THEN
 STR.DispALERT('مالك هذه البوليصة يختلف عن مالك باقي البوالص المربوطة على هذا البيان', 'ERROR');
 CLEAR_RECORD;
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 4, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 UPDATE VSSL_BLS
 SET DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = :VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ
 ;

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN.DT_PX THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
--&&& END
 UPDATE VSSL_MFSTS
 SET MFST_STG_CD = 5
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT
 ;
 END IF;

 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 EXECUTE_QUERY(NO_VALIDATE);
 STR.DISPALERT('تم ربط البوليصة علي البيان الجمركي','INFORMATION');


 END IF;
END;

 END IF;

 NEXT_ITEM;
END;

 CGUV$CHK_VB_BL_NBR_UK(

 ,:VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT /* IN : Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT. */

/* CGFK$QRY_LOOKUP_DATA */
/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('VSSL_BLS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$QRY_VSSL_BLS_VB_SHAG_FK(
 :VSSL_BLS.SHPG_AGNT_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.SHPG_AGNT_NAME. */
 ,:VSSL_BLS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR ); /* IN : Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد وكيل شحن مسجل بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VB_VM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رقم المانفيست غير صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_SHAG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد وكيل شحن مسجل بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_SHAG_B_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRIGHT_FORWARDER_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_SELF_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PARENT_BL_SEQ,PORT_CD,MFST_NBR,MFST_DT,MFST_TYPE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يوجد بيان إحصائي بهذا الرقم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_SDP_FK') THEN

 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_FP_FK') THEN

Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
IF NOT V_DISP_LOV THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('VBI');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.VBI_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.VBI_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2281_PROD_GLOBALS.VBI_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('VBI.L_VC_CNTNR_MRK');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((PORT_CD, MFST_NBR, MFST_TYPE, MFST_DT, nvl(to_char(CNTNR_SEQ), ''CG$NULL'')) IN '||'(SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_NBR, MFST_TYPE, MFST_DT, nvl(to_char(CNTNR_SEQ), ''CG$NULL'') '||'FROM VSSL_CNTNRS
 WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'أصناف بوليصة شحن','بوليصة الشحن البحري' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'أصناف بوليصة شحن','بوليصة الشحن البحري' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);

 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);

 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF V_REP_PRNT_FLG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 rep.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;*/

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

ProgramUnit.Name: CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE
