/* CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE */
PROCEDURE CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE IS
BEGIN
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
/* Read the values for dynamic lists from the CG_REF_CODES table */
BEGIN
 CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
END;

/* CGLY$INIT_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$INIT_TAB_BLOCKS */
/* Initialise tabbed canvases */
BEGIN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
END;

/* CGBS$STARTUP */
/* Perform start-up processing for Block Synchronization */
BEGIN
 /* Set the defaults for the globals */
 :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 /* Set the relations to the default query mode */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the query mode items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MANIFEST TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SHPMT TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''BILL STATUS'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('BILLS.BILL_STATUS', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''BILL PRE TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('BILLS.BILL_PRE_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DO_ISS_LOC'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_LOC_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DLVY_ORDER_STATUS'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_STA_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''MFST_TYPES'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''BL_STATUS'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('VSSL_BLS.BL_STA_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''SHPMT_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('VSSL_BLS.SHPMT_TYPE_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_ */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_HDR_DCLTN_TYPE_(
 P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN NUMBER) IS /* Value in Item :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE TYPE_ID = P_DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGUV$CHK_A_DLVY_UK */
PROCEDURE CGUV$CHK_A_DLVY_UK(
 P_MFST_NBR IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_MFST_TYPE IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_MFST_YEAR IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_SHPMT_TYPE IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_BILL_DT IN DATE /* Item value */
 ,P_BILL_NBR IN VARCHAR2 /* Item value */
 ,P_CARR_PREFIX IN NUMBER /* Item value */
 ,P_DLVY_DT IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT. */
 ,P_DLVY_NBR IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR. */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_RECORD_STATUS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* The ROWID */
/* Check uniqueness against primary/unique constraint */
/* Note : NO_DATA_FOUND exception handled by calling trigger */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 IF (P_RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT') THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND (CARR_PREFIX = P_CARR_PREFIX OR
 (CARR_PREFIX IS NULL AND
 P_CARR_PREFIX IS NULL ))
 AND (BILL_NBR = P_BILL_NBR OR
 (BILL_NBR IS NULL AND
 P_BILL_NBR IS NULL ))
 AND (BILL_DT = P_BILL_DT OR
 (BILL_DT IS NULL AND
 P_BILL_DT IS NULL ))
 AND SHPMT_TYPE = P_SHPMT_TYPE
 AND (MFST_YEAR = P_MFST_YEAR OR
 (MFST_YEAR IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_YEAR IS NULL ))
 AND (MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE OR
 (MFST_TYPE IS NULL AND
 P_MFST_TYPE IS NULL ))

ProgramUnit.Name: CGUV$CHK_VB_BL_NBR_UK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGUV$CHK_VB_BL_NBR_UK */
PROCEDURE CGUV$CHK_VB_BL_NBR_UK(
 P_BL_NBR IN VARCHAR2 /* Item value */
 ,P_MFST_TYPE IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE. */
 ,P_MFST_DT IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT. */
 ,P_MFST_NBR IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR. */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_BL_SEQ IN VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ. */
 ,P_RECORD_STATUS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* The ROWID */
/* Check uniqueness against primary/unique constraint */
/* Note : NO_DATA_FOUND exception handled by calling trigger */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 IF (P_RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT') THEN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT
 AND BL_NBR = P_BL_NBR;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
 ELSE
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT
 AND BL_NBR = P_BL_NBR
 AND P_BL_SEQ != BL_SEQ
 AND P_PORT_CD != PORT_CD
 AND P_MFST_NBR != MFST_NBR
 AND P_MFST_DT != MFST_DT
 AND P_MFST_TYPE != MFST_TYPE;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(' لا يمكن إصدار إذن تسليم جديد - يوجد إذن تسليم لهذا الجزء من البوليصة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_DTL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هل السجل مدخل مسبقاً - أعد إدخال سجل جديد', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDO_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'DO_ISS_DT,SHPG_AGNT_NBR,DO_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم وكيل الشحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', '' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'م. البوليصة,رمز المنفذ,رقم المانفيست,تار' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'VB_BL_NBR_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يمكن تكرار الرقم الأصلي للبوليصة على نفس المانفيست', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم وكيل الشحن' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SHAG_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', '' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'A_DLVY_ORDER_CHECK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيانات الفسح بالشرح أو الربط ببيان إستيراد متداخلة أو غير مكتملة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_TYPE_CHECK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('بيانات البوالص غير متناسبة مع نوع الشحن', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BILL_SHPMT_TYPE_CHECK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(10, 'Invalid value for <p1>', 'النوع المبدئي للبوليصة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 10);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMPORT_BLS') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يكون تاريخ تخزين البوليصة أو جمرك التسليم بدون قيمة،راجع المساندة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(
 P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Find the canvases associated with the current canvas and record which */
/* base canvas is displayed in each window */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_current_canvas = 'CG$M_TAB_1') THEN
 P_base_canvas := 'CG$PAGE_1';
 ELSE
 P_BASE_CANVAS := P_CURRENT_CANVAS;
 END IF;
 IF (get_view_property(P_CURRENT_CANVAS, WINDOW_NAME) = 'CGSO$WINDOW_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$WINDOWCGSO$WINDOW_1_PAGE := P_BASE_CANVAS;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS */
PROCEDURE CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(
 P_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Current canvas */
/* Raise the current canvas, plus any dependant canvases to the top */
BEGIN
 set_view_property(P_CANVAS, VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 IF ( P_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 set_view_property('CG$M_TAB_1', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT */
PROCEDURE CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT IS
/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255);
BEGIN
 IF ( (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS IS NULL) OR (:CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS != current_canvas) ) THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$LAST_CANVAS := current_canvas;
 set_window_property( get_view_property( current_canvas, WINDOW_NAME ), VISIBLE, PROPERTY_ON);
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 canvas_list := :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST;
 END IF;
 CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(canvas_list, current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF ( base_canvas = 'CG$PAGE_1') THEN
 :CG$CTRL.CG$PAGE_1_LIST := canvas_list;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_INV_COST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--WAKEEL CR-6555

PROCEDURE UPDATE_INV_COST (P_SR_VAL NUMBER, P_MODE NUMBER) -- 1 PLUS 2 MINUS
IS
 V_INV_CURCY_CD NUMBER;
 V_RATE NUMBER;
 V_SR_VAL NUMBER :=0;
 V_TOT_ORG_WT NUMBER := 0 ;
BEGIN
 IF DO_AIR.VALID_COLLECTION_DCLTN (:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD,
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) = 1
 THEN
 SELECT INV_CURCY_CD
 INTO V_INV_CURCY_CD
 FROM DCLTN_INVOICES
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF P_MODE = 2
 THEN
 V_TOT_ORG_WT := :GLOBAL.TOT_ORG_WT * -1 ;
 ELSE
 V_TOT_ORG_WT := NVL(:GLOBAL.TOT_ORG_WT,0) ;
 END IF;



 IF V_INV_CURCY_CD = 100
 THEN
 IF P_MODE = 2
 THEN
 V_SR_VAL := NVL(P_SR_VAL,0) * -1;
 ELSE
 V_SR_VAL := NVL(P_SR_VAL,0) ;
 END IF;

 UPDATE DCLTN_INVOICES
 SET TOTAL_EXPS = TOTAL_EXPS + V_SR_VAL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET INV_COST = INV_COST + V_SR_VAL , GROSS_WT = GROSS_WT+V_TOT_ORG_WT ,net_wt = net_wt+V_TOT_ORG_WT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 ELSE
 V_RATE :=
 REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (TO_NUMBER (V_INV_CURCY_CD),
 hijdate_db.cur_hij_date);
 V_SR_VAL := P_SR_VAL / V_RATE;

 IF P_MODE = 2
 THEN
 V_SR_VAL := V_SR_VAL * -1;
 END IF;

 UPDATE DCLTN_INVOICES
 SET TOTAL_EXPS = TOTAL_EXPS + V_SR_VAL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;

 UPDATE DCLTN_ITEMS
 SET INV_COST = INV_COST + V_SR_VAL ,GROSS_WT = GROSS_WT+V_TOT_ORG_WT , net_wt = net_wt+V_TOT_ORG_WT
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 END IF;


 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TRY_QUERY

PROCEDURE try_query IS --MAIH --
V_PORT_CD NUMBER;
V_CARR_PREFIX NUMBER;
V_BILL_NBR NUMBER;
V_BILL_DT DATE;
BEGIN
CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
enter_query;

select PORT_CD ,CARR_PREFIX,BILL_NBR,BILL_DT
INTO V_PORT_CD ,V_CARR_PREFIX,V_BILL_NBR,V_BILL_DT
from AIR_DLVY_ORDERS
where PORT_CD =:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND STMT_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;

:BILLS.PORT_CD := V_PORT_CD ;
:BILLS.CARR_PREFIX := V_CARR_PREFIX ;
:BILLS.BILL_NBR := V_BILL_NBR ;
:BILLS.BILL_DT := V_BILL_DT ;
execute_query;
EXCEPTION
WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOV_BILLS_DCLTN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LOV_BILLS_DCLTN IS -- WAKEEL DM_0142
 RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;

 DWHERE VARCHAR2(1000) := '( EXISTS (SELECT 1
FROM BILL_DTLS L_BLD
WHERE AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_YEAR = L_BLD.MFST_YEAR
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE = L_BLD.MFST_TYPE
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE = L_BLD.SHPMT_TYPE
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR = '|| :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR ||'
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD = L_BLD.PORT_CD
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX = ' || :GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX ||'
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR = L_BLD.MFST_NBR
AND AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT = L_BLD.BILL_DT
AND L_BLD.BILL_TYPE_CD <> 3
))' ;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE ', TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة البوالـــص المتاحه لربطها علي البيان');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .7);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .8);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BILL_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :SEARCH_BLK.BILL_NBR_SRCH);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_STMT_ISN', TEXT_PARAMETER, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN);



 CALL_FORM('LOV_BILLS_DCLTN.fmx ',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);


IF :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :GLOBAL.PORT_CD := :BILLS.PORT_CD;
 --:GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 :GLOBAL.BILLS_DCLTN := 1 ;
 --SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS',DEFAULT_WHERE,DWHERE);
 GO_BLOCK('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY ;
END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'LOV_BILLS'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOV_BILLS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LOV_BILLS(V_FILTER BOOLEAN DEFAULT NULL) IS
RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('BILLS_LOV');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('BILLS_LOV');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE ', TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة البوالـــص المتاحه لربطها علي البيان');

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .8);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_SHPMT_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 2);
-- MAIH 16-03-2013 ------------------------------------------------
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BILL_PRE_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 ELSIF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BILL_PRE_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 3);
 END IF;
-------------------------------------------------------------------
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_EXPRT_STA', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);

 IF V_FILTER THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BILL_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER, :BILLS.BILL_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CARR_PREFIX', TEXT_PARAMETER, :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX);
 END IF;


 CALL_FORM('LOV_AIR_BILLS.fmx ',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);


IF :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX :=:GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX;
 :BILLS.BILL_NBR :=:GLOBAL.BILL_NBR;
 :BILLS.BILL_DT :=:GLOBAL.BILL_DT;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'LOV_BILLS'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INS_AIR_DLVRY_ORDER_EXPRESS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2016/03/03 09:46 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
--MAIH 16-03-2013 تعديل خاص بادخال إذن تسليم وهمي لبوالص البريد السريع --

PROCEDURE ins_air_dlvry_order_express
IS
 bill_rec bill_dtls%ROWTYPE;
 v_cnt NUMBER := 0;
 v_dlvy_nbr NUMBER;
 v_tot_charge NUMBER := 0;
 v_oprtn_user VARCHAR2 (30) := :parameter.p_user_id;
 V_RATE NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 V_SR_VALUE NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 V_BILL_DCLTN_STNDR_VAL NUMBER := NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('BILL_DCLTN_STNDR_VAL', 21), 0); -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 P_MSG_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000) ; -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 V_BILLS_CNT NUMBER ; -- WAKEEL CR_6555

BEGIN
 /*MAIH*/ -- str.dispalert('001','information');--
 -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 IF NVL (GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING ('AIR_BLS_COLL_DCLTN', 21), 0) = 1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_BILLS_CNT
 FROM BILLS B, SHPG_AGNTS SA
 WHERE B.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = SA.SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND PORT_CD = :bills.port_cd
 AND STMT_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;



 IF :BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY IS NULL OR :BILLS.BILL_PRICE_AMNT IS NULL THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('يجب اضافة سعر للبوليصة',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 --V_RATE := REVENUE.GET_CURRENCY_RATE (TO_NUMBER(:BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY), hijdate_db.cur_hij_date);
 -- V_SR_VALUE := :BILLS.BILL_PRICE_AMNT * V_RATE;
 IF :BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT > V_BILL_DCLTN_STNDR_VAL THEN
 P_MSG_DESC :=' قيمة البوليصة '
 || ' رقم '
 || :BILLS.BILL_NBR
 || ' بتاريخ '
 || TO_CHAR(:BILLS.BILL_DT,'DD-MM-YYYY')
 || ' أكبر من القيمة الاساسية ' ;


 str.dispalert
 ( P_MSG_DESC ,
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 UPDATE bills
 SET BILL_PRICE_AMNT =:BILLS.BILL_PRICE_AMNT ,
 BILL_CURRENCY =:BILLS.BILL_CURRENCY ,
 BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT =:BILLS.BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt ;
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF V_BILLS_CNT >= 999 AND Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') -- wakeel cr-6555
 THEN
 str.dispalert
 ('لا يمكن اضافة اكثر من 999 بوليصة على البيان',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 UPDATE BILLS
 SET STMT_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt
 AND STMT_ISN IS NULL
 AND STATS_ISN IS NULL
 ;
 -- wakeel cr-6555
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN -- wakeel cr-6555
 STR.DISPALERT('تم ربط البوليصة علي البيان الجمركي','INFORMATION');
 UPDATE_INV_COST (:GLOBAL.BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT , 1) ; -- wakeel cr-6555
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;

 --commit;
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');

END IF;
 -- wakeel cr-6555

/*
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := NULL ;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR := NULL ;
 :GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX := NULL ;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_DT := NULL ;
*/
 END IF;

 -- WAKEEL CR_6555

 IF :parameter.p_post_express = 1 AND :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 THEN
 /*MAIH*/-- str.dispalert('002','information');--
 SELECT --*
 port_cd, carr_prefix, bill_nbr,
 bill_dt, shpmt_type, mfst_nbr,
 mfst_year, mfst_type, mfst_qty,
 mfst_wt, arvd_qty, arvd_wt,
 arrival_dt, bill_type_cd, left_cd,
 left_dt, old_bill, note,
 bill_status, edi_sta_cd,
 next_port_cd, close_trans_stat,
 free_zoon_st
 INTO --bill_rec
 bill_rec.port_cd, bill_rec.carr_prefix, bill_rec.bill_nbr,
 bill_rec.bill_dt, bill_rec.shpmt_type, bill_rec.mfst_nbr,
 bill_rec.mfst_year, bill_rec.mfst_type, bill_rec.mfst_qty,
 bill_rec.mfst_wt, bill_rec.arvd_qty, bill_rec.arvd_wt,
 bill_rec.arrival_dt, bill_rec.bill_type_cd, bill_rec.left_cd,
 bill_rec.left_dt, bill_rec.old_bill, bill_rec.note,
 bill_rec.bill_status, bill_rec.edi_sta_cd,
 bill_rec.next_port_cd, bill_rec.close_trans_stat,
 bill_rec.free_zoon_st
 FROM bill_dtls
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt
 AND ROWNUM = 1;

 --SELECT dlvy_order_seq.NEXTVAL
 -- INTO v_dlvy_nbr
 --FROM DUAL;
 SELECT GNRL.GET_SEQUENCE_VALUE (:parameter.p_curr_PORT_CD,'dlvy_order_seq') INTO v_dlvy_nbr FROM DUAL;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM air_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt
 -- AIR DEVELERY ORDER WITH DECLARATIONS OR STATS_DCLTN --
 AND ( (stmt_isn IS NOT NULL AND stmt_isn <> :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn)
 OR (stats_isn IS NOT NULL)
 );

 IF v_cnt > 0
 THEN
 /*MAIH*/ -- str.dispalert('003','information');--
 str.dispalert
 ('لا يمكن ربط البوليصه بالبيان يوجد إذن تسليم لهذه البوليصه مربوط على بيان آخر',
 'ERROR'
 );
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM air_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt
 AND stmt_isn IS NULL
 AND stats_isn IS NULL;

 IF v_cnt > 0
 THEN
 /*MAIH*/ -- str.dispalert('004','information'); --
 DELETE FROM air_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt;
 END IF;

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_cnt
 FROM air_dlvy_orders
 WHERE port_cd = :bills.port_cd
 AND bill_nbr = :bills.bill_nbr
 AND carr_prefix = :bills.carr_prefix
 AND bill_dt = :bills.bill_dt
 AND stmt_isn = :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn;

 IF v_cnt = 0
 THEN
 /*MAIH*/-- str.dispalert('005','information');--
 INSERT INTO air_dlvy_orders
 (port_cd, dlvy_nbr, dlvy_dt,
 dlvy_time, tot_charge, carr_prefix,
 bill_nbr, bill_dt, shpmt_type,
 mfst_nbr, mfst_year,
 mfst_type, oprtn_user,
 stmt_isn, clrnc_type
 )
 VALUES (:bills.port_cd, v_dlvy_nbr, hijdate_db.cur_hij_date,
 SYSDATE, v_tot_charge, :bills.carr_prefix,
 :bills.bill_nbr, :bills.bill_dt, bill_rec.shpmt_type,
 bill_rec.mfst_nbr, bill_rec.mfst_year,
 bill_rec.mfst_type, v_oprtn_user,
 :dcltn_hdr.dcltn_isn, 2
 );

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT'); --
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 -- wakeel cr-6555
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN -- wakeel cr-6555
 STR.DISPALERT('تم ربط البوليصة علي البيان الجمركي','INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 -- wakeel cr-6555

 END IF;
 /*MAIH*/ -- str.dispalert('006','information');--
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 str.dispalert ('حدث خطأ يرجى الإتصال بالمساندة الفنية ', 'error');
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXEC_FUNS

PROCEDURE EXEC_FUNS(CD VARCHAR2) IS
 RET NUMBER;
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'TMPLT_MOD_CALL';
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CNT_BILS NUMBER;
 V_DCL_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF CD LIKE 'CD_00990' THEN
 IF :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(RET_BILL_NBR) INTO V_CNT_BILS
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND A_CARR_PREFIX = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX
 AND A_BILL_NBR = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR
 AND A_BILL_DT = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT
 AND A_SHPMT_TYPE = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPMT_TYPE
 AND A_MFST_NBR = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR
 AND A_MFST_YEAR = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_YEAR
 AND A_MFST_TYPE = :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE
 AND NVL(STAGE_CD,0) <> 99 ;

 IF V_CNT_BILS > 0 THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('لايمكن فصل إذن التسليم بسبب ربط البوليصة بصنف محجوز !!!! لفصل إذن التسليم يجب أولاً إسترجاع الصنف ', 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF ;

 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم فصل إذن التسليم عن البيان الجمركي - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفصل','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 DEL_NON_PAID_DCLTN_STRGS;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 3, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.AIR_DLVY_ORDERS = 1 THEN
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.STMT_ISN := NULL;
 :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CLRNC_TYPE := NULL;

 :AIR_BL_DTLS.OWNER_NAME := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_QTY := NULL;
 :AIR_BL_DTLS.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL;
 -- BY SHERIFT 03-03-2005--
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.NEED_PRINT :=1;
 UPDATE_NEED_PRINT;
 --
 COMMIT;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('AIR_DLVY_ORDERS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR';
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.AIR_DLVY_ORDERS = 0 THEN

 UPDATE AIR_DLVY_ORDERS SET STMT_ISN = NULL , CLRNC_TYPE = NULL
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND CARR_PREFIX =:GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX
 AND BILL_NBR = :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR
 AND BILL_DT = :GLOBAL.BILL_DT ;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;

 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 END IF;
 -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 -- IF get_item_property(:SYSTEM.current_item,block_name)='AIR_DLVY_ORDERS' then
 IF :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.CARR_PREFIX IS NOT NULL
 AND :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.BILL_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 RET :=
 STR.DispALERT (
 'سيتم فصل البوليصه عن البيان الجمركي - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفصل',
 'CONFIRM');

 IF Ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (
 21,
 1,
 5,
 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD || '!' || :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 UPDATE BILLS SET STMT_ISN = NULL ,BILL_STATUS = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND CARR_PREFIX =:GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX
 AND BILL_NBR = :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR
 AND BILL_DT = :GLOBAL.BILL_DT ;

 UPDATE_INV_COST (:GLOBAL.BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT, 2) ; -- wakeel cr-6555



 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 ret := Str.Dispalert('تم فصل البوليصه عن البيان الجمركي بنجاح','INFORMATION');
 --IF :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.STMT_ISN IS NULL THEN
 :GLOBAL.BILL_NBR := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_DT := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.CARR_PREFIX := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 :GLOBAL.BILL_PRICE_SR_AMNT := NULL ; -- wakeel cr_6555
 :GLOBAL.TOT_ORG_WT := NULL ; -- wakeel cr_6555
 --END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF ;
 /*
 ELSIF get_item_property(:SYSTEM.current_item,block_name)='BILLS' then
 IF :BILLS.BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL
 AND :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX IS NOT NULL
 AND :BILLS.BILL_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 RET :=
 STR.DispALERT (
 'سيتم فصل البوليصه عن البيان الجمركي - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفصل',
 'CONFIRM');

 IF Ret = alert_button1
 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY (
 21,
 1,
 5,
 :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD || '!' || :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN)
 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 UPDATE BILLS SET STMT_ISN = NULL ,BILL_STATUS = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :BILLS.PORT_CD
 AND CARR_PREFIX = :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX
 AND BILL_NBR = :BILLS.BILL_NBR
 AND BILL_DT = :BILLS.BILL_DT ;

 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 */
 -- WAKEEL CR_6555
 END IF;
 ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_01000' THEN
 IF :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(RET_BILL_NBR) INTO V_CNT_BILS
 FROM RET_REPS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND S_MFST_PORT_CD = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_PORT_CD
 AND S_MFST_TYPE = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_TYPE
 AND S_MFST_NBR = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_NBR
 AND S_MFST_DT = :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.MFST_DT ;

 IF V_CNT_BILS > 0 THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('لايمكن فصل إذن التسليم بسبب ربط البوليصة بصنف محجوز !!!! لفصل إذن التسليم يجب أولاً إسترجاع الصنف ', 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF ;

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_DCL_COUNT
 FROM DCLTN_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND dcltn_items.cntnr_type IS NOT NULL ;

 IF V_DCL_COUNT >0 THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('يجب إستخدام وظيفة إلغاء التعامل مع الإرساليه كحاويات فارغه أولا بشاشة الربط بالأصناف ', 'ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم فصل إذن التسليم عن البيان الجمركي - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفصل','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 DEL_NON_PAID_DCLTN_STRGS;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 3, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 -- BEGIN BY A.HASSAN 30/10/03
 :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.LAST_DCLTN_ISN := :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN;
 -- END BY A.HASSAN 30/10/03

 :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN := NULL;

 -- BY SHERIFT 03-03-2005--
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.NEED_PRINT :=1;
 UPDATE_NEED_PRINT;
 --
 COMMIT;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('SEA_DLVY_ORDERS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR';
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;

 END IF;
 END IF;
--------------------------------
ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_01710' THEN
 IF :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT IS NOT NULL AND :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL
 AND :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 -- :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_DT', TEXT_PARAMETER,:SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_ISS_DT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_SHPG_AGNT', TEXT_PARAMETER,:SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,:SEA_DLVY_ORDERS.DO_NBR);
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DO_ISS_LOC', TEXT_PARAMETER,0);

 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.Dispalert('لايمكن عرض الشاشة لنقص أحد الحقول أو أكثر', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_01720' THEN
 IF :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DISPLAY_ONLY', TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DLVY_NBR', TEXT_PARAMETER,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_DLVY_DT', TEXT_PARAMETER,:AIR_DLVY_ORDERS.DLVY_DT);

 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.Dispalert('لايمكن عرض الشاشة لنقص أحد الحقول أو أكثر', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
---------------------------------------
 ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_01010' THEN
 IF :BILLS.BILL_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :BILLS.CARR_PREFIX IS NOT NULL AND :BILLS.BILL_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم فصل البوليصه عن البيان الجمركي - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفصل','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 5, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BILLS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 :BILLS.STMT_ISN := NULL;
 :BILLS.BILL_STATUS := 2;

 -- BY SHERIFT 03-03-2005--
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.NEED_PRINT :=1;
 UPDATE_NEED_PRINT;
 --
 COMMIT;
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('BILLS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR';
 :GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_01020' THEN
 IF :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 RET := STR.DispALERT('سيتم فصل البوليصه عن البيان الجمركي - هل ترغب في إستكمال الفصل','CONFIRM');
 IF Ret = alert_button1 THEN
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 5, :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD||'!'||:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('VSSL_BLS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);

--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
-- IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTN.DT_PX THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_PX') THEN
--&&& END

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM VSSL_BLS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT
 AND (DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL OR STATS_DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL)
 ;
 IF V_CNT = 1 THEN
 UPDATE VSSL_MFSTS
 SET MFST_STG_CD = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 :VSSL_BLS.DCLTN_ISN := NULL;

 -- BY SHERIFT 03-03-2005--

 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 :DCLTN_HDR.NEED_PRINT :=1;
 UPDATE_NEED_PRINT;

 COMMIT;



 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('VSSL_BLS', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('DCLTN_HDR', UPDATE_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 --:PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM := 'DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR';
 --:GLOBAL.EXEC_QRY_NOW := 1;
 GO_BLOCK('VSSL_BLS');
 EXECUTE_QUERY;
 END IF;
 END IF;

--==========================================================================================
--===================================== MAIH 27-06-2011 ====================================

--===================================وظيفة نقل البوالص الى مانفيست اخر=======================
--==========================================================================================
ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_02590' THEN


DECLARE
 ERROR_MSG VARCHAR2(300);
 MESSAGE_LEVEL NUMBER ;
 old_mnfst_nbr NUMBER;
old_mnfst_dt DATE;
BEGIN


-----------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------------
-----------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE
v_GATE_DT DATE ;
V_DCLTN_DYS_OF_RELEASE VARCHAR2(5) := NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DCLTN_DYS_OF_RELEASE',21),0);
BEGIN

 SELECT GATE_DT
 INTO v_GATE_DT
 FROM declarations

 WHERE DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN ;


IF v_GATE_DT IS NULL THEN

 NULL;

ELSIF (sysdate- HIJDATE_DB.TO_GREG(v_GATE_DT)) > V_DCLTN_DYS_OF_RELEASE THEN

 str.dispalert('لا يمكن الاستمرار لقد مر اكثر من شهر على الفسح','error');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;


END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;
END ;

-----------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------

old_mnfst_nbr:=:VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR;
old_mnfst_dt :=:VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT;

 IF STR.DISPALERT('سوف يتم نقل البوليصة إلى منافيست آخر . هل أنت متأكد؟','CONFIRM') = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 ELSE



 PL_NAME := 'LOV_VSSL_MFSTS';
 PL_ID := GET_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_NAME);
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 PL_ID := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_NAME);
 IF ID_NULL(PL_ID) THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('Error creating parameter list '||PL_NAME,'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_TITLE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة المنافيستات');
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_WIDTH',TEXT_PARAMETER,7.5);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_X_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,0.4);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'WINDOW_Y_POS',TEXT_PARAMETER,.8);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'ROW_COUNT',TEXT_PARAMETER,12);

 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'P_MFST_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE);

 CALL_FORM('LOV_VSSL_MFSTS.FMX',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,NO_QUERY_ONLY,PL_ID);

 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);

 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('Parameter list '||PL_NAME||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.MFST_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.MFST_NBR = old_mnfst_nbr AND :GLOBAL.MFST_DT = old_mnfst_dt THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لقد اخترت نفس رقم المنافيست سوف يتم الغاء النقل','INFORMATION');
 ELSE


 SEA_SHPMT.ENABLE_MAFAME;
 ---------------------- ---------------------- ---------------------- ---------------------- ----------------------
 RET := SEA_SHPMT.TRNFR_BL_TO_ANTHR_MFST(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, 1,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:VSSL_BLS.MFST_TYPE, :GLOBAL.MFST_NBR, :GLOBAL.MFST_DT,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_WS_ID, ERROR_MSG);
 ---------------------- ---------------------- ---------------------- ---------------------- ----------------------

 IF RET = 1 THEN
 MESSAGE_LEVEL:=:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL ;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 25;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 SEA_SHPMT.DISABLE_MAFAME;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := MESSAGE_LEVEL;
 STR.DISPALERT('تم إلغاء البوليصة ونقلها الى منافيست أخر','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 SEA_SHPMT.DISABLE_MAFAME;
 STR.DISPALERT(ERROR_MSG,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 end if;


 end if;

 end ;
--==========================================================================================
--========================================== END ===========================================
--==========================================================================================
-------------------------------- --


ELSIF CD LIKE 'CD_02410' THEN
 IF :VSSL_BLS.PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT IS NOT NULL AND
 :VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 THEN

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MFST_PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:VSSL_BLS.PORT_CD );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MFST_NBR' , TEXT_PARAMETER,:VSSL_BLS.MFST_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_MFST_DT' , TEXT_PARAMETER,:VSSL_BLS.MFST_DT );
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_BL_SEQ' , TEXT_PARAMETER,:VSSL_BLS.BL_SEQ );
 ELSE
 Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' NOT EXIST! INTERNAL ERROR','INFORMATION');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 ret := Str.Dispalert('لايمكن عرض الشاشة لنقص أحد الحقول أو أكثر', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 TERMINATE_FUN;
 END IF;
--==========================================================================================


 END IF;

END;

PROCEDURE DEL_NON_PAID_DCLTN_STRGS IS
CURSOR DCLTN_STRG_CUR IS
 SELECT *
 FROM DCLTN_STRGS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 ;

V_DATE DATE;
V_MSG_LEVEL NUMBER;
BEGIN
FOR I IN DCLTN_STRG_CUR LOOP
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
--IF NOT STRG.CHK_STRG_PAY_STAT(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, I.STRG_SEQ, I.PMNT_TYPE, V_DATE) THEN
 IF STRG.CHK_STRG_PAY_STAT(:DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD, :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN, I.STRG_SEQ, I.PMNT_TYPE, V_DATE) = 0 THEN
--&&& END
 DELETE DCLTN_DLVY_STRGS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND STRG_SEQ = I.STRG_SEQ
 ;

 DELETE DCLTN_STRGS

END LOOP;
V_MSG_LEVEL := :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL;
FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
:SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL:= V_MSG_LEVEL;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ARE_BL_PARTS_IN_PORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION ARE_BL_PARTS_IN_PORT(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER, V_MFST_NBR NUMBER,
 V_MFST_DT DATE, V_BL_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_BL_QTY NUMBER;
 V_IN_QTY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(ACTL_QTY)
 INTO V_BL_QTY
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = V_BL_SEQ
 ;
 V_BL_QTY := NVL(V_BL_QTY, 0);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_BL_QTY := 0;
 END;
 IF V_BL_QTY = 0 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(ENTRD_QTY)
 INTO V_IN_QTY
 FROM BL_ITEM_ENTRIES
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = V_BL_SEQ
 ;
 V_IN_QTY := NVL(V_IN_QTY, 0);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_IN_QTY := 0;
 END;

 IF V_BL_QTY <> V_IN_QTY THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 RETURN TRUE;
END;

FUNCTION ARE_BL_PARTS_IN_PORT(V_PORT_CD NUMBER, V_MFST_TYPE NUMBER, V_MFST_NBR NUMBER,
 V_MFST_DT DATE, V_BL_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_BL_WGT NUMBER;
 V_BL_QTY NUMBER;
 V_IN_WGT NUMBER;
 V_IN_QTY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(ACTL_WGT), SUM(ACTL_QTY)
 INTO V_BL_WGT, V_BL_QTY
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = V_BL_SEQ
 ;
 V_BL_WGT := NVL(V_BL_WGT, 0);
 V_BL_QTY := NVL(V_BL_QTY, 0);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_BL_WGT := 0;
 V_BL_QTY := 0;
 END;
 IF V_BL_WGT = 0 OR V_BL_QTY = 0 THEN
 RETURN FALSE;
 END IF;

 BEGIN
 SELECT SUM(ENTRD_WT), SUM(ENTRD_QTY)
 INTO V_IN_WGT, V_IN_QTY
 FROM BL_ITEM_ENTRIES
 WHERE PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND MFST_TYPE = V_MFST_TYPE
 AND MFST_NBR = V_MFST_NBR
 AND MFST_DT = V_MFST_DT
 AND BL_SEQ = V_BL_SEQ
 ;
 V_IN_WGT := NVL(V_IN_WGT, 0);
 V_IN_QTY := NVL(V_IN_QTY, 0);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_IN_WGT := 0;
 V_IN_QTY := 0;
 END;

 IF V_BL_WGT <> V_IN_WGT OR V_BL_QTY <> V_IN_QTY THEN

 RETURN TRUE;
END;

/*DECLARE

 x number := 0.0;

 RET PLS_INTEGER;

begin
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);
 SET_WINDOW_PROPERTY('CGSO$WINDOW_1',WINDOW_STATE,MAXIMIZE);

 WND := WIN_API_UTILITY.GET_ACTIVE_WINDOW();
 RET := SEC_DLL.IsWndCaptionDisplayed(WND);
 IF RET = 1 THEN
 TOGGEL_WND;
 END IF;

 Set_View_Property('EDI_MSG', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);

 TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_VIEW_Y_POS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VIEWPORT_Y_POS_ON_CANVAS );
 TMPLT.HEIGHT := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', HEIGHT);


 TMPLT.LOAD_FUNCTIONS(:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 TMPLT.ENB_DIS_FUN_BUT;


 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', visible, property_true);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('TOOLBAR', display_position, x,y);
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY ('TITLE', visible, property_true);

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXIT1',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('RE_ENTER_QUERY',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('LAST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FIRST_REC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_UP',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('PAGE_DOWN',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXECUTE',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 :GLOBAL.EXIT := 0;

 IF CHECK_TIMEOUT = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 hWind PLS_INTEGER;
 CheckTimer TIMER;
 BEGIN
 hWind := get_window_property(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,WINDOW_HANDLE);
 Win_API_Session.Timeout_Start_Timer(hWind);
 CheckTimer := Create_Timer('CheckTimeout',120000,repeat);
 END;
 END IF;
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF CHECK_EDI_ROLE_ID(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID) = TRUE THEN
IF CHECK_EDI_MSG_TIMER = TRUE THEN
 DECLARE
 TIMER_ID TIMER;
 V_VAR_VALUE VARCHAR2(200);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN VARCHAR2(200);
 BEGIN
 V_VAR_VALUE := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'EDI_MSG_TIMER',30);
 V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN := GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING(:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD,'MSG_DISPLAY_PERIOD',30);

 IF (V_VAR_VALUE IS NOT NULL AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN IS NOT NULL) AND
 (V_VAR_VALUE > 0 AND V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN > 0) THEN

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;

 TIMER_ID := Find_Timer('RETURN_EDI_MSG');
 IF Id_Null(TIMER_ID) THEN
 TIMER_ID := CREATE_TIMER('RETURN_EDI_MSG',V_VAR_VALUE_RETURN, REPEAT);
 ELSE
 Set_Timer(TIMER_ID,1, REPEAT);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
END IF;
END IF;
 :GLOBAL.G_TIME_OUT := 0;
 :GLOBAL.TIMER := 0;
 :global.item_name := NULL;


BEGIN
SYS.DBMS_APPLICATION_INFO.set_module (NVL(:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME,'NEBRAS')||' '||nvl(:GLOBAL.current_ver,' '), NULL);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
END;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-F9
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
DECLARE
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 VIS VARCHAR2(200);
 V_FUN VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN
 VIS := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE);
 V_FUN := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FUN_BUT',VISIBLE);

 IF VIS = 'TRUE' THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ELSE
 IF V_FUN = 'TRUE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');

 TMPLT.Populate_Functions;
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := TRUE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 1;
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$TAB_BLOCK_MANAGEMENT */
/* Switch tab management code on/off */
DECLARE
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);
 base_canvas VARCHAR2(61);
BEGIN
 CGLY$GET_RELATED_CANVASES(current_canvas, base_canvas);
 IF( base_canvas IN ( 'CG$PAGE_1' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 ELSE
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := FALSE;
 END IF;
END;
/* CGLY$MANAGE_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$TAB_NEW_BLOCK */
/* Show canvases for this block */
BEGIN
 IF CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE = TRUE THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGBS$WHEN_NEW_BLOCK_INSTANCE */
/* ensure the current canvas is correctly coordinated */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.NEW_BLOCK( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CQUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CQUERY_FRM */
/* Check if query is allowed to avoid unnecessary coordination */
BEGIN
 IF (get_block_property( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'FALSE') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(37, 'Query not allowed in this block'), 'E', 'OFG', 37);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CGBS$.DO_KEYQRY( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, 'COUNT_QUERY', :SYSTEM.MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN
 IF ( CGBS2$.IS_RECORD_DIRTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTKEY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */
/* Disable KEY-NXTKEY for the whole form */
BEGIN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(30, 'Key not valid in this context'), 'E', 'OFG', 30);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGCF$PERFORM_STARTUP */
/* execute the when-new-form-instance code that was created by forms generator */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TAB-PAGE-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$NEW_TAB_PAGE */
/* Show related canvases for this tab */
BEGIN
 IF( :SYSTEM.TAB_NEW_PAGE IN ( 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_1', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_2', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_3', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_4' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$TAB_CHANGED;
 END IF;
END;

BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
